source_title: Norsk Hydro sees up to $210 million hit from gas supply disruption at Alunorte
quote: Norsk Hydro (OTCMKTS: NHYDY) said on Monday it could take a financial hit of up to $210 million as it continues to buy gas at spot-market prices following disruptions to natural gas deliveries at its Alunorte refinery in Brazil.

source_title: Norsk Hydro sees up to $210 million hit from gas supply disruption at Alunorte
quote: The Norwegian company estimates a $75 million to $100 million impact to its bauxite and alumina business in the third quarter due to lower production and purchase of gas above contracted prices.

source_title: Norsk Hydro sees up to $210 million hit from gas supply disruption at Alunorte
quote: It expects a further $90 million to $110 million hit in the fourth quarter from gas arbitrage costs at Alunorte.

source_title: Norsk Hydro sees up to $210 million hit from gas supply disruption at Alunorte
quote: Hydro said gas supplier CELBA notified Alunorte in August that gas availability had been disrupted.

source_title: Norsk Hydro sees up to $210 million hit from gas supply disruption at Alunorte
quote: The refinery, in Brazil's northern state of Para, had cut output to 50% of capacity earlier that month due to disruptions.

source_title: Norsk Hydro sees up to $210 million hit from gas supply disruption at Alunorte
quote: Alunorte had begun ramping up alumina production to full capacity after reaching a temporary agreement with CELBA in August.

source_title: Norsk Hydro sees up to $210 million hit from gas supply disruption at Alunorte
quote: Alunorte does not expect further supply interruptions stemming from the current situation, and is working closely with CELBA, Hydro said.
